X12 Indexer

Source: R/indexers.R
index_x12.Rd

X12 Indexer

Usage

index_x12(text)

Arguments

text

<chr> string of raw X12-820 text

Value

<hcc::X12Index> S7 object

Examples

purrr::map(
  c(hcc::x12_820,
    hcc::x12_834,
    hcc::x12_837I,
    hcc::x12_837P
   ),
   index_x12
 )
